review.summary: The change adds an optional `services.discord.mention_id` (from `DISCORD_MENTION_ID`), validates it as a trimmed 17-20 digit snowflake, appends `\n<@ID>` to every alert, and reserves the mention's length so the whole content stays within 1800 characters, with docs and thorough Pest coverage. Implementation is small, secure and matches the task; the only gap is the missing `[Unreleased]` CHANGELOG entry required by the project conventions.
